info.name: Sakura's Crying
info.parent: Sakura, the Kitty, and the Orange Marble

descriptions.notStarted: I should go see Sakura, who's crying. I wonder if I can help...
descriptions.inProgress: I better talk to Sakura, who still weeps in sorrow. There must be something that I can do, but what?
descriptions.completed: Sakura murmured something while crying. Perhaps this is the reason behind the flowing tears...
